mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.product_id AS productId, p.name AS productName, c.sku_id AS skuId, sku.spec AS skuSpec, sku.image AS productImage, sku.price, c.quantity, c.checked, sku.stock FROM t_cart c LEFT JOIN t_product p ON p.id = c.product_id LEFT JOIN t_product_sku sku ON sku.id = c.sku_id WHERE user_id = #{userId}
